vector-valued-functions-displacement.alt: The path of p(t) = <2t, 6t minus t squared> for t from 0 to 6, an arch from (0, 0) up to (6, 9) at t = 3 and down to (12, 0) at t = 6, with points at each whole t. Position vectors p(1) = <2, 5> and p(3) = <6, 9> are drawn from the origin in blue, and the displacement vector p(3) minus p(1) = <4, 4> is drawn from the tip of p(1) to the tip of p(3) in vermillion.

vector-valued-functions-path.alt: The path of a vector-valued function for t from 0 to 6, an arch through (0, 0), (2, 5), (4, 8), (6, 9), (8, 8), (10, 5) and (12, 0) at t = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. Position vectors p(1) and p(4) are drawn from the origin to (2, 5) and (8, 8).
